questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

18 – 12 ÷ 4 + 8 × 2 = 5
questions.solution:
Given equation -

18 – 12 ÷ 4 + 8 × 2 = 5

Apply BODMAS rule -

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2091d3cebaae2d9ac49f0f4a3d14b79d4faccd8b9d4bf391771328b8ce79574e.png] 

From option 1 -

18 – 12 ÷ 4 + 8 × 2 = 5

– and ÷, then -

18 ÷ 12 – 4 + 8 × 2 = 5

1.5 – 4 + 8 × 2 = 5

1.5 – 4 + 16 = 5

17.5 – 4 = 5

13.5 ≈ 5 It does not follow.

From option 2 -

18 – 12 ÷ 4 + 8 × 2 = 5

÷ and ×, then -

18 – 12 × 4 + 8 ÷ 2 = 5

18 – 12 × 4 + 4 = 5

18 – 48 + 4 = 5

22 – 48 = 5

–26 ≈ 5 It does not follow.

**From option 3 -**

**18 – 12 ÷ 4 + 8 × 2 = 5**

**+ and –, then -**

**18 + 12 ÷ 4 – 8 × 2 = 5**

**18 + 3 – 8 × 2 = 5**

**18 + 3 – 16 = 5**

**21 – 16 = 5**

**5 = 5, It is follow.**

From option 4 -

18 – 12 ÷ 4 + 8 × 2 = 5

+ and ÷, then -

18 – 12 + 4 ÷ 8 × 2 = 5

18 – 12 + 0.5 × 2 = 5

18 – 12 + 1 = 5

19 – 12 = 5

7 ≈ 5 It does not follow.

Hence, **"option 3"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All jasmines are flowers.

No flower is a plant.

Some plants are herbs.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some jasmines are herbs.

II. No jasmines is a herb.

III. No jasmine is a flower.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Either conclusion I or II follows
Only conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
**Note: This is previous year paper and given answer as per the official answer key.**

The diagram are given below -

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf98356af96a053e34878466bedb7cd5bb1fcc2e4fef50ea7f41e884c4d46e06.png] 

I. Some jasmines are herbs. → False (All jasmines are flowers, no flower is a plant and some plants are herbs from this we see that there is nothing common between jasmines and herbs.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/324a7039660b06c7fa247ef0c7bcf39de789301e7013b6ea661de6416da71060.png] 

II. No jasmines is a herb. → False (No flower is a plant, some plants are herbs. from this we see that there is not direct no relation between flower and herb, so no relation establish.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75ab37d47f668b9935545e173683d6f7b5a9c341462823694b2501e47d7e01cb.png] 

Or,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32cd5ad644be1fe0fa4688639c915c9a2e2f735c415f40814bd2b3d5ba50476a.png] 

III. No jasmine is a flower. → False (All jasmines are flowers from this we see that all jasmines are followers then never be no relation between jasmine and flower.)

When we combining the statement I and II we can say that either I or II follows 

**Either conclusion 1 or 2 follows.**

Hence, **"option 3"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

If no flower is a herb is true, then no jasmine will be herb because all jasmine are flowers

If some jasmines are herbs is true, then some flowers will be herbs because all jasmine are flowers. Then no flower is a herb will be false.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

**Conditions of Either-or case:**

1. Individually both the conclusions should be false.

2. One conclusion should be positive and one conclusion should be negative (Complementary pair)

The two complementary pairs are:

**1) All + Some not**

**2) No + Some**

The logic followed here is:

Square root of first number and square root of third number we get both value and add it and multiply with 3 we get second number.

**{9, 21, 16}**

**√9 = 3, √16 = 4, (3 + 4) × 3 = 7 × 3 = 21**

**Similarly,**

__**From option 1 -**__

**{36, 42, 64}**

**√36 = 6, √64 = 8, (6 + 8) × 3 = 14 × 3 = 42. It is follow.**

From option 2 -

{16, 32, 27}

√16 = 4, √27 = 5.9, it is not follow.

From option 3 -

{4, 20, 18}

√4 = 2, √18 = 4.242, (2 + 4.242) × 3 = 6.242 × 3 = 18.727 ≈ 20. It is not follow.

From option 4 -

{8, 60, 12}

√8 = 2.82, √12 = 3.46, (2.82 + 3.46) × 3 = 6.28 × 3 = 18.84 ≈ 60. It is not follow.

Hence, "option 1" is the correct answer.
